studio.tutorial.pen.title: dweba ngepeni
studio.tutorial.pen.summary: Dweba umugqa ngqo kukhanvasi engenalutho futhi ulungise usayizi nokufiphaza.
studio.tutorial.pen.step.1.title: Khetha ithuluzi lepeni
studio.tutorial.pen.step.1.body: Chofoza ipeni kubha yamathuluzi engezansi noma cindezela ukhiye B. Usukulungele ukudweba.
studio.tutorial.pen.step.2.title: usayizi nokugxila
studio.tutorial.pen.step.2.body: Lungisa usayizi webhulashi nokufiphala kwezinketho zomdwebo. Ungakwazi ukushintsha usayizi ngokushesha ngokhiye othi [ ].
studio.tutorial.pen.step.3.title: dweba ngokwemvelo
studio.tutorial.pen.step.3.body: Uma ukhulula isandla sakho ngemva kokudweba umugqa, ukushaywa okukodwa kuzogcinwa. Ungabuyela emuva nganoma yisiphi isikhathi nge-⌘Z.
studio.tutorial.pen.step.3.tip: Uma ukuzamazama kukukhathaza, zama ukukhulisa kancane inketho yokuzinzisa.
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.title: amajamo ahlakaniphile
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.summary: Ngisho noma ucishe udwebe umugqa, isikwele, indilinga, noma unxantathu, ungawucwenga ube umumo ohlanzekile lapho uyeka.
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.step.1.title: Vula kumodi yokubhala
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.step.1.body: Ngepeni elikhethiwe, vula umumo ohlakaniphile ezinkethweni zomdwebo ukuze UVULIWE.
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.step.2.title: dweba njengesimo
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.step.2.body: Dweba imigqa, izikwele, imibuthano, onxantathu, namapholigoni nge-stroke eyodwa. Uma umisa kancane ekugcineni, kuzovela ukubuka kuqala.
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.step.3.title: Kuqinisekiswa uma ususa isandla sakho
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.step.3.body: Lapho uyikhulula, ingena esimweni esihle. Uma ungayithandi, ungayibuyisela ngokuthi ⌘Z.
studio.tutorial.smart-shape.step.3.tip: Imibuthano iyabonakala kalula uma ixhumeke kancane ekugcineni, futhi onxantathu bangabonwa uma ama-vertices egobile ngokucacile.
studio.tutorial.brush.title: ibhulashi kit
studio.tutorial.brush.summary: Shintsha ukuma kwenhliziyo ngamabhulashi ngezinhloso ezahlukene, njengamapensela, omaka, amabhulashi, nama-highlighters.
studio.tutorial.brush.step.1.title: ithreyi lokuxubha
studio.tutorial.brush.step.1.body: Vula uhlu lwebhulashi ezinkethweni zomdwebo bese ukhetha ukuthungwa okufunayo.
studio.tutorial.brush.step.2.title: londoloza ku-slot
studio.tutorial.brush.step.2.body: Amabhulashi asetshenziswa njalo angalondolozwa endaweni ethi ⇧1–6 futhi alayishwe ngokuqondile ngo-1–6.
studio.tutorial.brush.step.3.title: ngombala
studio.tutorial.brush.step.3.body: Khetha umbala oyinhloko bese uwudweba. Ungashintsha umbala oyinhloko nombala wesibili ngokhiye X.
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.title: ibhulashi lokuxuba umbala
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.summary: Ibhulashi elifana nopende elisetshenziswa ngokuxuba umbala waphansi phezu kwebhulashi.
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.step.1.title: Vula isendlalelo sesithombe
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.step.1.body: Ngemva kokukhetha isendlalelo sesithombe ozopenda, chofoza ibhulashi lokuxuba imibala kubha yamathuluzi engakwesokunxele noma cindezela u-⇧N.
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.step.1.tip: Ungasebenzisa imibala exubile ngokuhlanganisa imivimbo edwetshiwe esithombeni.
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.step.2.title: Hlanganisa upende
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.step.2.body: Lapho upenda kakhulu, umbala waphansi udlulela ebhulashini futhi uhlangane ngokwemvelo. Lungisa inani lokushumeka ne-pigment ezinkethweni.
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.step.3.title: hlola ukushaywa unhlangothi
studio.tutorial.wet-mix.step.3.body: Uhlangothi olulodwa luhlehlisa okukodwa. Faka umbala ngesibindi bese uhlehlela emuva ngokuthi ⌘Z ukuze uyizwe kahle.
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.title: ibhulashi elikabili
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.summary: Dala ukuthungwa okuyinkimbinkimbi njengephepha kanye ne-watercolor ngokugqagqana amathiphu amabili ebhulashi.
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.step.1.title: Vula Isitudiyo Sebhulashi
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.step.1.body: Iya ku-Brush Studio ohlwini lwebhulashi kuzinketho zokudweba.
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.step.2.title: Vula ibhulashi elikabili
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.step.2.body: Vula ukusetshenziswa kwamabhulashi amabili bese ukhetha ithiphu yesibili nemodi eyinhlanganisela. Ithiphu yesibili imodela ukuthungwa kwethiphu eyinhloko.
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.step.3.tip: Ngokushintsha nje imodi yokuqamba, umkhathi ushintsha kakhulu.
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.step.3.title: Buka kuqala bese ulondoloza
studio.tutorial.dual-brush.step.3.body: Cwenga usayizi nesikhala ngokubheka i-stroke yokubuka kuqala, futhi uma uthanda, yigcine njengokusetha ngaphambilini.
studio.tutorial.sketch-shape.title: amajamo womdwebo
studio.tutorial.sketch-shape.summary: Shintsha umumo ube umugqa onyakazayo (rough.js) obukeka sengathi udwetshwe ngesandla.
studio.tutorial.sketch-shape.step.1.body: Dweba umumo onjengezikwele nama-oval kukhanvasi bese uwakhetha ngethuluzi lokukhetha.
studio.tutorial.sketch-shape.step.2.body: Vula umdwebo odwetshwe ngesandla kumugqa/isitayela somumo sephaneli yezakhiwo.
studio.tutorial.sketch-shape.step.3.body: Lungisa ukuhwalala, ukugoba, nokugcwala kokugcwalisa (ukuchanyuselwa, njll.) ukuze kufane nomuzwa wokuqhubeka noma i-graffiti.
studio.tutorial.sketch-shape.step.3.tip: Uma uyivula esiteji se-storyboard, umthwalo uzokwehla ngoba isithombe ngeke sibukeke siphelile.
studio.tutorial.special-rulers.title: Izinhlobo ezi-3 zababusi abakhethekile
studio.tutorial.special-rulers.summary: Dweba kalula imigqa yangemuva ngokunqamula imigqa emigqeni ehambisanayo, imibuthano egxilile, namarula e-radial.
studio.tutorial.special-rulers.step.1.bo: Uma ungakhethi lutho kumodi yokubhala, engeza imigqa ehambisanayo, imibuthano egxilile, namarula e-radial kuzilungiselelo zethuluzi lokudweba ezivelayo.
studio.tutorial.special-rulers.step.2.bo: Hambisa i-engeli nephoyinti eliphakathi nendawo ukuze livumelane nesimo. Amarula amaningi angaboniswa futhi kusetshenziswa isifinyezo esisodwa kuphela.
studio.tutorial.special-rulers.step.3.bo: Uma udweba umugqa onerula esebenzayo evuliwe, izonqamula kumhlahlandlela. Ilungele imigqa yemvula, imigqa yesivinini, nemigqa yokugxila.
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.title: Dodge/Burn/Sponge
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.summary: Gcoba ngebhulashi ukuze ulungise ukukhanya kancane nokugcwaliswa kwesikhala.
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.step.1.title: Vula esithombeni
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.step.1.body: Ngemva kokukhetha isendlalelo sesithombe ofuna ukusilungisa, chofoza okuthi Dodge/Burn kubha yamathuluzi noma cindezela u-O.
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.step.2.title: Khetha imodi
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.step.2.body: I-Dodge iyakhanya, i-Burn iba mnyama, futhi isiponji siphakamisa noma sehlise ukugcwala. Ungakhetha futhi ububanzi (isithunzi, ithoni ephakathi, gqamisa).
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.step.3.title: buthaka izikhathi eziningana
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.step.3.body: Kubukeka kungokwemvelo kakhulu ukugcina ukuchayeka kuphansi futhi uhlikihle izikhathi ezimbalwa. Uhlangothi olulodwa luhlehlisa okukodwa.
studio.tutorial.dodge-burn.step.3.tip: Zama ukuqala ezindaweni ezincane njengokuthinta kwebhola kanye namalambu amarimu angemuva.
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.title: imaski esheshayo
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.summary: Lena imodi yesitayela se-Photoshop Q ependa futhi icwenge indawo yokukhetha ngebhulashi.
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.step.1.title: Ngena no-Q
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.step.1.body: Khetha isendlalelo sesithombe bese ucindezela u-Q. Ukukhethwa kwephikseli yamanje kuphenduka kube imbondela enemibala (imaski).
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.step.1.tip: Ungaphinda uqale kuphaneli yeMask esheshayo kuthebhu ethi Khetha/Thinta kabusha.
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.step.2.title: Penda futhi ucwenge
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.step.2.body: Ukudweba ngebhulashi kunezela ekukhetheni, futhi ukudweba kwimodi yokusula kuyakususa. I-twist nayo iyenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa.
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.step.3.title: Iqedile ngendawo yokukhetha
studio.tutorial.quick-mask.step.3.body: Cindezela okuthi Q futhi ukuze uguqule imaski enqunyiwe ibe ukukhetha kwephikseli. Imiphetho ebushelelezi igcinwa ngezimpaphe.
studio.tutorial.color-range.title: Khetha ububanzi bombala
studio.tutorial.color-range.summary: Khetha amaphikseli ombala afanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa njengendawo yokukhetha.
studio.tutorial.color-range.step.1.title: Vula ithebhu ethi Khetha/Thinta kabusha
studio.tutorial.color-range.step.1.body: Khetha isendlalelo sakho sesithombe bese uthola isigaba se-Colour Range kuthebhu ethi Khetha/Thinta kabusha yezakhiwo zayo.
studio.tutorial.color-range.step.2.title: Umbala ojwayelekile nokubekezelelana
studio.tutorial.color-range.step.2.body: Uma ukhetha umbala ojwayelekile futhi ulungisa ukubekezelela, uzobona indawo ezokhethwa njengokuhlola kuqala.
studio.tutorial.color-range.step.3.title: Khetha okuthi Faka
studio.tutorial.color-range.step.3.body: Uma isetshenziswa, ukukhethwa kwephikseli kwakhiwa ngokuya ngemodi yamanje yokuhlanganisa (ukukhetha okusha, hlanganisa, khipha). Bese, ungafaka umbala ngokulungile noma uwususe.
studio.tutorial.color-range.step.3.tip: Ifaneleka ngokukhethekile ezindaweni ezinemibala ecacile, njengesibhakabhaka noma izinwele.
studio.tutorial.bubble.title: ibhamuza lenkulumo
studio.tutorial.bubble.summary: Khetha izwi elifanele indawo, njengokukhuluma, ukucabanga, noma ukumemeza.
studio.tutorial.bubble.step.1.title: Khetha uhlobo
studio.tutorial.bubble.step.1.body: Bheka inkhulumomphendvulwano, imizwa, neqembu le-UI eliqondisayo kumenyu yebhamuza lenkulumo phezulu bese ukhetha umumo.
studio.tutorial.bubble.step.1.tip: Ngisho noma ukhetha cishe, ungashintsha umumo kamuva ezicini.
studio.tutorial.bubble.step.2.title: Faka imigqa yakho
studio.tutorial.bubble.step.2.body: Chofoza kabili (noma thepha) ibhamuza lenkulumo kukhanvasi ukuze uhlele umbhalo. Uma kukhethiwe, umbala, umsila, kanye nomkhathi kungalungiswa ezicini ezingakwesokudla.
studio.tutorial.bubble.step.3.title: ukushintsha kwemizwa
studio.tutorial.bubble.step.3.body: Qondanisa imibala, imigqa, nomumo ngesikhathi esisodwa nokushintshashintsha kwemizwa kuphaneli yezakhiwo.
studio.tutorial.dialogue.title: Engeza imigqa ngesikhathi esisodwa
studio.tutorial.dialogue.summary: Uma unamathisela umbhalo, amabhamuza enkulumo abekwa emugqeni.
studio.tutorial.dialogue.step.1.title: ifomethi yombhalo
studio.tutorial.dialogue.step.1.body: Umugqa owodwa ngomugqa. Ku-「Igama: Ingxoxo」, izipikha ziyahlukaniswa, futhi kokuthi 「(Izigxivizo zeminwe)」, iba yibhokisi lokulandisa.
studio.tutorial.dialogue.step.2.title: Faka konke ngesikhathi esisodwa
studio.tutorial.dialogue.step.2.body: Yinamathisele endaweni yokokufaka ngaphansi kwemenyu yebhamuza lenkulumo bese uchofoza okuthi “Faka njengebhamuza lenkulumo ngesikhathi esisodwa.”
studio.tutorial.dialogue.step.3.title: Hlela Ngenqwaba
studio.tutorial.dialogue.step.3.body: Ungahlela imigqa esivele ilayishwe ngesikhathi esisodwa usebenzisa "Ukuhlela komugqa weqoqo."
studio.tutorial.template.title: ukusika isifanekiso
studio.tutorial.template.summary: Faka izakhiwo ezifana ne-webtoon eqondile, i-4-cut, negridi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
studio.tutorial.template.step.1.title: Khetha isifanekiso
studio.tutorial.template.step.1.body: Khetha ukulungiselelwa okufana ne-webtoon eqondile noma igridi kumenyu ye-Link/Isifanekiso.
studio.tutorial.template.step.2.title: Ukudweba ngaphakathi kohlaka
studio.tutorial.template.step.2.body: Faka izithombe, amabhamuza enkulumo, nezinhlamvu kusikwe ngasinye (uhlaka). Amafreyimu ahlakaza indawo.
studio.tutorial.template.step.3.title: shintsha usayizi
studio.tutorial.template.step.3.body: Ungalungisa ubude ngokukhetha ubude bekhanvasi noma uzimele. Kungcono ukubeka ama-webtoon okuskrola aqonde phezulu.
studio.tutorial.layers.title: Izendlalelo kanye Nokukhethwa
studio.tutorial.layers.summary: Khetha ama-elementi agqagqene futhi uwahlele nge-oda, ngokufihla, nokukhiya.
studio.tutorial.layers.step.1.title: Khetha
studio.tutorial.layers.step.1.body: Uma uthepha into ngethuluzi lokukhetha, izogqanyiswa kuhlu lwesibaluli/Isendlalelo.
studio.tutorial.layers.step.2.title: shintsha i-oda
studio.tutorial.layers.step.2.body: Hudula uhlu lwesendlalelo noma sebenzisa okuthi ⌘] / ⌘[ ukuze ubuyele emuva naphambili.
studio.tutorial.layers.step.3.title: Kufihliwe/Kukhiyiwe
studio.tutorial.layers.step.3.body: Fihla noma ukhiye noma yiziphi izici eziphazamisayo ngenkathi usebenza ukuze zinganyakazi ngephutha.
studio.tutorial.layers.step.3.tip: Ungakwazi ukuhamba kahle ngo-1px ngokhiye bemicibisholo nango-10px ngokhiye bemicibisholo ethi ⇧+.
studio.tutorial.path-boolean.title: Hlanganisa amajamo
studio.tutorial.path-boolean.summary: Dala umumo owodwa ngokuhlanganisa, ukususa, noma ukuphambana namajamo amabili.
studio.tutorial.path-boolean.step.1.body: Khetha izimo ezimbili ofuna ukuzihlanganisa ngokuhudula noma u-Shift+ngokuchofoza.
studio.tutorial.path-boolean.step.2.body: Khetha Ukuhlanganisa, Khipha, Phambana, noma Hlukanisa kusukela Kunhlanganisela Yomumo kuphaneli Yezakhiwo.
studio.tutorial.path-boolean.step.3.body: Izimo ezihlanganisiwe ziba yindlela eyodwa. Uma ungakuthandi, buyela ku-⌘Z bese uzama futhi.
studio.tutorial.path-boolean.step.3.tip: Kuyafaneleka uma udala izimo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezifana nama-silhouette ebhamuza lenkulumo noma izimpawu.
studio.tutorial.character.title: Izinhlamvu ze-3D
studio.tutorial.character.summary: Setha inkundla ngokuma komlingiswa we-VRM, imvunulo, nezinsizakusebenza.
studio.tutorial.character.step.1.title: Engeza uhlamvu
studio.tutorial.character.step.1.body: Engeza imodeli noma ukusetha ngaphambilini kusuka kumenyu yezinhlamvu bese uyibeka kukhanvasi.
studio.tutorial.character.step.2.title: shaya ukuma
studio.tutorial.character.step.2.body: Qondanisa ukunyakaza kwakho nokusethwa kusengaphambili noma ukukhohlisa okuhlanganyelwe.
studio.tutorial.character.step.3.title: Izimpahla zokugqoka kanye nezinsiza
studio.tutorial.character.step.3.body: Engeza i-ambiance ethile nge-wardrobe kanye nohlu lwezinsiza. Uma kuzwakala kungenangqondo, zama ukulungisa indawo kancane.
studio.tutorial.bg3d.title: Ingemuva le-3D
studio.tutorial.bg3d.summary: Dala ngokushesha indawo engemuva ngegumbi, umgwaqo, futhi usethe izifanekiso.
studio.tutorial.bg3d.step.1.title: isifanekiso sesigcawu
studio.tutorial.bg3d.step.1.body: Khetha izifanekiso ezifana namagumbi nezitaladi kusukela kungemuva le-3D futhi ukubeke ngesikhathi esisodwa.
studio.tutorial.bg3d.step.2.title: Ukubekwa Kwento
studio.tutorial.bg3d.step.2.body: Hambisa ifenisha nezinsiza futhi uzivumelanise nezifinyezo zaphansi. Ungayihlela ngokuyifihla nokukhiya.
studio.tutorial.bg3d.step.3.title: umqondo wekhamera
studio.tutorial.bg3d.step.3.body: Zama ukushintsha umbono nokukhanya kancane ukuze usethe isimo se-cut.
studio.tutorial.mannequin.title: Unodoli wokudweba we-3D
studio.tutorial.mannequin.summary: Misa unodoli ohlangene futhi uyisebenzise njengomdwebo womzimba womuntu.
studio.tutorial.mannequin.step.1.title: Vula unodoli wokudweba
studio.tutorial.mannequin.step.1.body: Vula Unodoli Wokudweba we-3D kubha yamathuluzi. Ukuzungezisa nokukhulisa kuyimisebenzi efanayo neyezinhlamvu ze-3D.
studio.tutorial.mannequin.step.2.title: shaya ukuma
studio.tutorial.mannequin.step.2.body: Hudula amalunga ukuze udale ukunyakaza noma uqale kusukela ekumisweni kusengaphambili kwe-pose. Ungakwazi futhi ukushintsha isimo somzimba wakho ngesilayida se-proportion.
studio.tutorial.mannequin.step.3.title: Faka njengomdwebo
studio.tutorial.mannequin.step.3.body: Ngemva kokuyifaka kukhanvasi, yehlisa ukukhanya bese wengeza umugqa phezulu ukuze uwusebenzise njengomhlahlandlela wokudweba umzimba womuntu.
studio.tutorial.mannequin.step.3.tip: Uma i-engeli inzima kakhulu, izoshesha kakhulu uma ujikisa unodoli kuqala bese uyamdweba.
studio.tutorial.room-builder.title: dala igumbi
studio.tutorial.room-builder.summary: Vimba ngokushesha isakhiwo segumbi ngokushintsha ubukhulu.
studio.tutorial.room-builder.step.1.body: Khetha ukudala igumbi kusuka kungemuva le-3D. Igumbi eliyisisekelo elinephansi nezindonga liyalungiswa.
studio.tutorial.room-builder.step.2.body: Lungisa ububanzi, ubude, ubude nezicabha nezindawo zefasitela. Uma ushintsha inani, igumbi lizokwakhiwa kabusha ngokushesha.
studio.tutorial.room-builder.step.3.body: Ungabeka ifenisha nama-props ngokungeza endaweni yesigameko. Setha isimo sesikhathi sosuku ngama-solar rigs nokukhanyisa.
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.title: Usizo lwe-AI
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.summary: Vulela izigcawu ngamathuluzi asizayo njengeziphakamiso zengxoxo nokubhala kabusha.
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.step.1.title: Vula Ihabhu
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.step.1.body: Khetha ithebhu yethuluzi oyidingayo kumenyu ye-AI Assist.
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.step.2.title: Ukubeka umongo
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.step.2.body: Ukusikisela kwakho kuzofaneleka kakhudlwana uma ubhala phansi isigameko, isikhulumi, nephimbo kafushane. Sicela uhlele imiphumela esikhundleni sokuyibhala njengoba injalo.
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.step.2.tip: Ezinye izici zingase zidinge ukhiye wakho we-API (BYOK).
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.step.3.title: kubonakala kukhanvasi
studio.tutorial.ai-assist.step.3.body: Namathisela umusho owuthandayo kubhamuza lenkulumo noma uwusebenzise ngenkinobho ethi Faka.
studio.tutorial.export.title: ukuthekelisa
studio.tutorial.export.summary: Londoloza futhi wabelane ngomsebenzi wakho nesipele se-PNG·JSON, njll.
studio.tutorial.export.step.1.title: Londoloza njengesithombe
studio.tutorial.export.step.1.body: Khetha isikali (isb. 2× PNG) ekulandeni ngenhla bese ulondoloza.
studio.tutorial.export.step.2.title: isipele somsebenzi
studio.tutorial.export.step.2.body: Ngekhophi yasenqolobaneni ye-JSON, ungagcina zonke izendlalelo namabhamuza enkulumo. Sicela ulayishe kabusha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
studio.tutorial.export.step.3.title: Hlola ngaphambi kokuthumela
studio.tutorial.export.step.3.body: Ungayibheka futhi ngaphambi kokuthumela/ukulayisha, futhi uthumele kuphela ukusikeka okudingayo.
studio.tutorial.gif-export.title: Thumela i-GIF/APNG
studio.tutorial.gif-export.summary: Londoloza ukugqwayiza kozimele njengamafayela e-GIF angadlalwa noma yikuphi.
studio.tutorial.gif-export.step.1.title: Dala uhlaka
studio.tutorial.gif-export.step.1.body: Khetha isendlalelo sesithombe bese udala ukugqwayiza kweseli elifushane ngokunqwabelanisa ozimele kuphaneli yokugqwayiza kozimele.
studio.tutorial.gif-export.step.2.title: Khetha Ifomethi
studio.tutorial.gif-export.step.2.body: Khetha i-GIF noma i-APNG ukuze uyithumele. I-GIF idlala noma yikuphi, futhi i-APNG inekhwalithi engcono.
studio.tutorial.gif-export.step.3.title: Londoloza futhi wabelane
studio.tutorial.gif-export.step.3.body: Uma usuhlole isivinini nokuphindaphinda futhi ukulondoloze, uzothola ifayela lokugqwayiza ongabelana ngalo ngaso leso sikhathi.
studio.tutorial.gif-export.step.3.tip: I-GIF iyamukeleka ekulayisheni umphakathi, futhi i-APNG yamukelekile ukuze kugcinwe ikhwalithi yesithombe.
